Booking Kyoto? Since 1 March 2026 the city's hotel tax can be up to ¥10,000 per person per night. Here's what it adds to a normal room, so the total doesn't surprise you at check-in 👇

🔗 Our checked notes for this one 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-where-to-stay-first-trip

🧾 THE NEW RATES (per person, per night)

💴 Room under ¥6,000 per person: ¥200

💴 ¥6,000–19,999: ¥400

💴 ¥20,000–49,999: ¥1,000

💴 ¥50,000–99,999: ¥4,000

💴 ¥100,000 or more: ¥10,000

✅ WHAT THAT MEANS

A room at ¥30,000 for two (¥15,000 each) adds ¥400 per person per night. A ryokan at ¥120,000 for two (¥60,000 each) adds ¥4,000 each. Check whether a listing's price already includes it.

📅 ONE MORE BOOKING TIP

Kyoto's tourism office suggests booking as early as possible for cherry blossom season, autumn leaves and the Gion Matsuri in July, because cheaper rooms go first.

💬 OUR TAKE

Budget the tax in from the start, and pick your area by train line: Shijo-Karasuma puts Kyoto Station 3 minutes away.
